points: A safe rollout exposes a change to a small share of real traffic first, watches it, and widens only if it behaves.
Configuration and data files need the same stages as code, because a bad file can break every machine as fast as bad code.
Amazon describes the mechanism: a one-box stage, waves of growing size, alarms that roll back, and a bake time between stages.
Cloudflare's feature file and CrowdStrike's content update each reached a very large fleet with no small first step to stop them.

figures.label: Feature limit of 200 features, against about 60 in use
A one-box stage serves at most ten percent of requests

prerequisiteReasons.load-balancing: Safe deployments take from load balancing the way traffic is split across servers, which lets a new version take a small share first.
